title: Refuse a cd that leaves the session's worktree
why: Triage cd'd to ~/.claude/hooks twice on 2026-11-10 (16:3x and 17:08 CST). The shell reset cwd to /home/user, which broke worktree agent spawns until a cd back. A guard that refuses a cd out of the session's worktree, with the remedy to use git -C or an absolute path, stops it.
